messages:
eli: Heads-up: release CI is blocked by a regen diff on feature/regen-fix. It only reorders changelog array items and tweaks a README example line but semver guard is failing the publish.

morgan: That sounds like nondeterministic generator output. Do we have a quick way to tell if it's docs-only?

regen-bot: pipeline: typegen #5201 failed (exit 1). Artifact: /artifacts/typegen/2976543210/regendiff.txt

tara: Snippet from regendiff: ```diff
-  - tags: ["beta", "quickstart"]
+  - tags: ["quickstart", "beta"]
```

kevin: Also noticed python README now says `default_retries: 4` while node README shows `default_retries: 2` after the regen. That breaks the sampleapp parity test intermittently.

eli: Proposals: 1) short-term: change semver guard to WARN for docs-only changes (changelogs, README/examples) and surface a warning in the release UI; 2) add a regen idempotence CI job that runs `scripts/regen` twice for PRs touching openapi/ or generator/ and fails if git status is dirty; 3) add a lightweight DX parity check that diffs auth/retry doc blocks across generated SDK READMEs and flags DX.

morgan: Agreed. We should not silently allow contract changes, so WARN + manual review is fine. Long-term we must make generator deterministic.

tara: I'll put up a quick PR to canonicalize $ref traversal order and normalize arrays in changelog metadata to reduce noise.

kevin: I'll add the README parity check to sampleapp CI and gate the double-regen job to PRs that touch generator or spec files to save CI minutes.

eli: Nice. Filing INC ticket so release can be unblocked once semver guard tweak lands: https://redwood-internal/ops/INC-2060-regen-order-noise.

morgan: Also add an idempotence unit test for an anyOf-heavy schema in the generator test-suite. That should catch this early.

tara: Will do. Targeting both fixes today so the release queue stops piling up.

kevin: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
